```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Set up the report runtime environment and load the shared pipeline functions.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
# Locate the pipeline root from the Rmd file location or the working directory (compatible with both render and interactive runs, without relying on .git/.Rproj).
input_dir <- tryCatch(
  dirname(normalizePath(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE), mustWork = FALSE)),
  error = function(e) ""
)
root_candidates <- unique(normalizePath(
  c(input_dir, getwd(), file.path(getwd(), "snRNAseq_publication_pipeline")),
  mustWork = FALSE
))
pipeline_root <- root_candidates[
  file.exists(file.path(root_candidates, "R", "pipeline_helpers.R"))
][1]
if (is.na(pipeline_root)) {
  stop("Cannot locate the pipeline root containing R/pipeline_helpers.R", call. = FALSE)
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = pipeline_root)
source(file.path(pipeline_root, "R", "pipeline_helpers.R"))
```

## Configuration

```{r libraries}
# Read pseudobulk settings and DEG significance thresholds from the central parameter file.
source(file.path(pipeline_root, "config", "pipeline_params.R"))

# Check and load the packages required for pseudobulk DEG analysis; DESeq2 is an optional method.
check_packages(c("Seurat", "SeuratObject", "Matrix", "edgeR", "dplyr", "ggplot2", "here"))

library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(edgeR)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

paths <- get_pipeline_paths(project_root = dirname(pipeline_root))
fig_dir <- ensure_dir(file.path(paths$fig_dir, "05_Pseudobulk_DEG"))
table_dir <- ensure_dir(file.path(paths$table_dir, "05_Pseudobulk_DEG"))

run_deseq2 <- requireNamespace("DESeq2", quietly = TRUE)
# Minimum cell count, DEG thresholds, and target cell type lists are all defined in config/pipeline_params.R.
```

## Pseudobulk DEG functions

```{r functions}
# Perform pseudobulk aggregation and differential expression analysis for a single cell type within one tissue.
run_one_celltype <- function(obj, tissue, celltype) {
  if (!celltype %in% unique(obj$CellType_Fine)) {
    message("Skipping missing cell type: ", tissue, " / ", celltype)
    return(NULL)
  }

  pb <- make_pseudobulk(
    obj,
    celltype = celltype,
    min_cells_per_mouse = min_cells_per_mouse
  )
  if (is.null(pb)) {
    message("Skipping insufficient pseudobulk replicates: ", tissue, " / ", celltype)
    return(NULL)
  }

# safe_name is used to build an output file name prefix free of special characters.
  safe_name <- paste(sanitize_label(tissue), sanitize_label(celltype), sep = "_")

# The edgeR QL F-test is the default pseudobulk DEG method.
  edge_res <- run_edgeR_pseudobulk(pb)
  edge_res$Tissue <- tissue
  edge_res$CellType <- celltype
  edge_res$Method <- "edgeR_QLF"
  write.csv(edge_res, file.path(table_dir, paste0("05_", safe_name, "_edgeR_pseudobulk_DEG.csv")), row.names = FALSE)

  p_volcano <- plot_deg_volcano(
    edge_res,
    title = paste(tissue, celltype, "edgeR pseudobulk", sep = " - "),
    fdr_cutoff = fdr_cutoff,
    logfc_cutoff = logfc_cutoff
  )
  save_pub_plot(p_volcano, paste0("05_", safe_name, "_edgeR_volcano"), fig_dir, width = 6, height = 5)

# If DESeq2 is installed in the environment, run it as an additional complementary result.
  deseq_res <- NULL
  if (isTRUE(run_deseq2)) {
    deseq_res <- tryCatch(run_deseq2_pseudobulk(pb), error = function(e) {
      message("DESeq2 failed for ", tissue, " / ", celltype, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    })
    if (!is.null(deseq_res)) {
      deseq_res$Tissue <- tissue
      deseq_res$CellType <- celltype
      deseq_res$Method <- "DESeq2"
      write.csv(deseq_res, file.path(table_dir, paste0("05_", safe_name, "_DESeq2_pseudobulk_DEG.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
    }
  }

  saveRDS(pb, file.path(paths$rds_dir, paste0("05_", safe_name, "_pseudobulk_counts.rds")))

# Return the pseudobulk counts and per-method DEG results for downstream enrichment analysis.
  list(
    pseudobulk = pb,
    edgeR = edge_res,
    DESeq2 = deseq_res
  )
}

# Run DEG analysis in batch for multiple target cell types within one tissue.
run_tissue <- function(obj, tissue, targets) {
  out <- lapply(targets, function(celltype) run_one_celltype(obj, tissue, celltype))
  names(out) <- targets
  out[!vapply(out, is.null, logical(1))]
}
```

## Run pseudobulk DEG

```{r run_deg}
# Run pseudobulk DEG for the spleen and bone marrow target cell types separately.
deg_results <- list(
  Spleen = run_tissue(sc_spleen, "Spleen", target_spleen),
  BoneMarrow = run_tissue(sc_bm, "BoneMarrow", target_bm)
)

saveRDS(deg_results, file.path(paths$rds_dir, "05_pseudobulk_deg_results.rds"))
```

## DEG summary table

```{r summary_table}
# Summarize the number of significant DEGs per tissue, cell type, and method.
summarise_deg <- function(res_list, tissue_name) {
  bind_rows(lapply(names(res_list), function(celltype) {
    methods <- c("edgeR", "DESeq2")
    bind_rows(lapply(methods, function(method) {
      res <- res_list[[celltype]][[method]]
      if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)
      data.frame(
        Tissue = tissue_name,
        CellType = celltype,
        Method = unique(res$Method),
        TestedGenes = nrow(res),
        FDR_0_05 = sum(res$FDR < fdr_cutoff, na.rm = TRUE),
        Up_FDR_0_05_logFC_0_5 = sum(res$FDR < fdr_cutoff & res$logFC >= logfc_cutoff, na.rm = TRUE),
        Down_FDR_0_05_logFC_0_5 = sum(res$FDR < fdr_cutoff & res$logFC <= -logfc_cutoff, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    }))
  }))
}

deg_summary <- bind_rows(
  summarise_deg(deg_results$Spleen, "Spleen"),
  summarise_deg(deg_results$BoneMarrow, "BoneMarrow")
)

# Save the DEG summary table for a quick view of which cell types show significant differences.
write.csv(deg_summary, file.path(table_dir, "05_pseudobulk_deg_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
deg_summary
```
